title: A Bird Hits the Ocean at 60 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: A bird hits the ocean at 60 miles an hour.
The northern gannet dives from about 100 feet up, headfirst.
It has no external nostrils, so water can't blast up its nose.
Air sacs in its face and chest cushion the impact like a car's airbags.
Its eyes sit far back on its face to help it judge the distance before it hits.
A 100-foot crash dive, every time it's hungry.

description:
A northern gannet hits the water at up to 60 miles an hour.
It dives from about 100 feet, and air sacs cushion the impact like airbags.
It even has no external nostrils.
Would you ever dive from that height?
first_comment: Would you ever dive from 100 feet into the sea?
